notes.title: Update version 1.4
notes.content:
Update version 1.4.
A small but nice update for you all as a Christmas present!

Tired of the solid black or grey color borders? This update brings new border styles: Sixteen (16) gradients and three (3) bezel images to enrichen the visuals.

Also the game will not automatically resume when brought back from background - it opens the pause menu instead!

notes.title: Crisis Wing turns one! Anniversary update version 1.1.2 out now!
notes.content:
Crisis Wing will turn one in 18th of September. To commemorate the launch of the game a new version is available!

Version 1.1.2 will include:
[list]
[*] Reduced the difficulty of the Boss Rush mode - it's still tough as nails but not borderline impossible!
[*] Improved controller support
[*] Features requested by the community
[*] Quality-of-life improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Update Version 1.1.1 coming soon!
notes.content:
Crisis Wing will get some brand new coat of paint with the upcoming 1.1.1 version.
This will be the [i]definitive[/i] version of the game.

The key features for the update are:
[list]
[*] Mac OSX version!
[*] 24 Steam Achievements to collect
[*] Jukebox to listen the game soundtrack in the Sound Options Menu.
[/list]

The 1.1.1 will be available shortly - don't miss on this one!

notes.title: Major Update 1.1.0 is Now Live
notes.content:
[h1]1.1.0 Version is now Live![/h1]

[u]New Game Mode:[/u]

• Added Boss Rush Mode to the game. The mode will have a brand new stage to play as well as unique boss at the end.

[u]Bugfixes:[/u]

• Fixed the mercy power-up spawning if player died without an active sub-weapon.
• Fixed odd behaviour in Video Options menu if resolution, filter mode or windowed option was selected.

[u]Adjustments:[/u]

• Added dimmers to overlay UI views.

[u]Additions:[/u]
• Added three (3) new music tracks.
• Added an option to choose the player ship color in the single-player game modes.

[u]Technical Upgrade:[/u]

• Added an option to choose either pixel-perfect aspect or to fully stretch the game view to a display.

[u]Quality-of-life Changes:[/u]

• Mapped 'Back' button to controllers. The 'Back' works similarly as the Escape key - it will pop up the in-game menu or goes back one step in the main menu views. Please visit [i]controller action mapping[/i] view to map the back button.
• Added an option to replay completable game modes (Time Attack, Practice, Boss Rush) without needing to visit the main menu.
• Added an option to choose the starting point (beginning, halfway or boss) in the practice mode.

notes.title: Upcoming 1.1.0 Major Update - New Boss Rush Game Mode and more!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Boss Rush game mode:[/b][/h3]
[i]Already 1CC'd? Too easy? Try the Boss Rush mode![/i]

Battle against the onslaught of beefed up-versions of the game bosses and mid-bosses. 
Face them back-to-back in gut-wrenching gauntlet - [i]with no continues allowed![/i] How long you'll survive?
[b]All new final boss[/b] awaits at the end of the boss-rush mode for to truly test your skills!

[h3][b]Other cool stuff in the patch:[/b][/h3]
* Three new cool music tracks!
* Option to play single-player modes with either the Red or Blue ship.
* Quality-of-life improvements suggested by the community!
* (The obvious) bug fixes.

[h2][i][b]Available on Wed. March 24 ![/b][/i][/h2]
